messages:
Maya P: Heads-up — after yesterday's launch metrics we need to lock a plan for post-release pruning and a short surge for bug fixes.
Alex L: Agreed. Key ask: reduce P1 queue by >50% in next 7 days. Can we get dedicated slots?
Sam: What counts as P1 here? customer-facing crashes and memory OOMs only?
Maya P: Yes. P1 = crashes/incorrect outputs on production flows. P2 = regressions that affect UX but have workarounds.
Jordan: I can allocate two engineers from runtime for the next 3 days for triage. :hammer_and_wrench: 
Emily: I’ll coordinate QA runlists and add regression prompts for the top 10 customer flows. Will tag failures with `prune/urgent`.
Alex L: Suggest we run a 'pruning pass' over backlog: close stale enhancement requests older than 6mo or convert to RFCs.
Sam: +1. We should also freeze new feature merges to main for 72h except hotfixes. deploy-bot: "deploy window locked — hotfixes only".
deploy-bot: deploy window locked — hotfixes only
Maya P: Rollout criteria for next minor: no P1s open for >48h, pass canary for 24h, and SLO on token latency within 5%.
Jordan: For capacity: can we spin an extra dedicated instance pool for high-throughput reranks? Ops + billing signoff?
Alex L: I'll ping finance and ops. If we request a 24h burst, estimate cost ~0.6T. Need product approval.
Maya P: Approve the 24h burst for triage only. Track cost to the launch budget code `LD-042`.
Emily: QA checklist uploaded: https://redwood.internal/qa/checklists/postrelease-prune — includes prompts, perf baseline, and smoke steps.
Sam: For backlog grooming — I'll prepare a small script to tag candidates: `last_updated > 180d AND votes < 3 -> prune-suggest`.
Alex L: Make sure customer-reported enhancements are excluded from auto-prune. We need manual review for those.
Maya P: Action items:
- Jordan: allocate runtime engineers (2) — due EOD
- Emily: run QA lists and surface P1s — start now
- Sam: produce prune-suggest list and PR to triage board — due tomorrow 10am
- Alex: cost signoff for burst — ASAP
Sam: I'll add a short triage rubric in the board: severity, customer impact, fix size, ownerability.
Emily: If we hit more than 3 P1s after the burst, we start a rolling spine-rollout and extend burst.
Alex L: :thumbsup: Let's sync 30m after initial triage. Maya, want to run the meeting?
Maya P: Yes. 11:30am quick sync. Bring triage board link and QA failures. :calendar:
Jordan: Noted. Starting allocation now.
Sam: Script pushed to `infra/triage-scripts/prune_suggest.sh` — running first pass.
Emily: Uploading failing traces to the board.
Maya P: Thanks team. Keep updates in this thread and tag me for escalations. :eyes:
